unresolved_blockers.summary: tools/independent_audit.py gate never recomputes epoch_digest, so a fabricated epoch yields ALLOW
unresolved_blockers.evidence: A hand-written epoch.json naming commit ffff...ffff with epoch_digest 'sha256:not-a-real-epoch-digest' and an empty files list, plus a receipt echoing those three values, exits 0 with {"decision": "ALLOW"}.
unresolved_blockers.fix: In gate(), recompute _digest(_canonical(epoch without epoch_digest)) and compare; optionally re-derive the epoch from the repository at gate time and compare head_sha and policy_digest.

unresolved_blockers.summary: epoch_digest is not reproducible across auditors because it digests the local origin URL
unresolved_blockers.evidence: The same base and head in two clones of the same repository yield epoch_digest sha256:9f4a5dae... over an https origin and sha256:9eca0174... over an ssh origin; policy_digest is identical in both.
unresolved_blockers.fix: Exclude 'repository' from the digested material, or normalise it to a canonical form before digesting.
